body:
I can't reproduce this with [Bistro-Demo-Tweaked/4.4-lightmap](https://github.com/Jamsers/Bistro-Demo-Tweaked/tree/4.4-lightmap) on 4.4.dev https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/04692d83cb8f61002f18ea1d954df8c558ee84f7 (Linux, GeForce RTX 4090 with NVIDIA 560.35.03).

System VRAM utilization goes up to 7.4 GB while baking lightmaps, so you probably need a GPU with at least 8 GB of VRAM for the bake to succeed. The **laptop** 3060 only has 6 GB of VRAM (while the desktop one has 12 GB).

Thanks for the report! Consolidating in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/98180, as this is due to the same cause (running out of VRAM).
